ACCOUNTABILITY_SHAPE: A V3 accountability callout does not have the expected shape (heading, stamp, body, summary line).
Restore the callout's shape; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_VERIFY_FAILED: A V3 accountability write did not read back as written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_WRITE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: A write outside the callout was refused before it was sent.
ACCOUNTABILITY_DEGRADED: Jira could not be read for at least one person; that callout shows DEGRADED with its last accepted text.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: A V3 register row is missing, or its callout is not on the Jim & Matt V3 page.
Restore the register row; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_SUMMARY_SHAPE: A V3 summary page does not hold exactly one paragraph.
Restore the page; nothing was written.
ACCOUNTABILITY_JIRA_BAD_PAGE: Jira returned a search page in an unexpected shape.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_JIRA_TOO_MANY_PAGES: A Jira search needed more pages than the bound allows.
None; retried on the next run.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_GOAL_AMBIGUOUS: One MEJ project Epic is linked to multiple current-quarter goal Epics, so attribution is ambiguous.
Correct the Jira Relates links with Matt's approval; the V3 goal update was refused.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_COMPLETION_DATE_MISSI: A linked MEJ project Task is Done but Jira has no status-category transition date; quarter attribution cannot be proven.
Keep prior V3 summary; verify Jira status history before publishing a versioned metric.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_COMPLETION_HISTORY_UN: A v2 MEJ Done Task has no complete, verified first transition into Done in Jira history.
Keep previous KPI; inspect complete Jira changelog and reconcile the first Done transition.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_APPROV: The quarter's frozen MEJ Task-to-goal baseline is missing, malformed or not approved.
Record and approve an exact immutable quarter membership matrix before enabling v2.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_MEMBERSHIP_DRIFT: A frozen MEJ Task's type, parent, goal link or existence differs from the approved quarter baseline.
Stop v2 KPI publishing; reconcile Jira with the approved frozen baseline.
ACCOUNTABILITY_MEJ_METRIC_VERSION_INVALI: MEJ metric mode must be v1 or v2; no other value is allowed.
Keep v1 until K2/K3 validation and approved v2 cutover are complete.
